body.statement: Restrict the inference result to the binary-treatment submodel \(\mathcal A=\{d,e\}\). For every \(P\in\mathcal P^r\) satisfying \(P\{D\in\{d,e\}\}=1\), the primitive moment map satisfies \((p(P),\omega(P))\in\mathfrak D_+^r\), \(\mathfrak I_a^r(p(P),\omega(P))=\mathcal I_a^r(P)\) for \(a\in\{d,e\}\), and \(\mathfrak I_{\Delta}^r(p(P),\omega(P))=\mathcal I_{\Delta}^r(P)\). Under the fixed known binary-treatment grid and ranges, \(\Pr_P\{(p(P),\omega(P))\in\mathcal H_n\}\ge1-\alpha\), and therefore \(\inf_{P\in\mathcal P^r:\,P\{D\in\{d,e\}\}=1}\Pr_P\{\mathcal I_{\Delta}^r(P)\subseteq\mathcal C_n\}\ge1-\alpha\) for every \(n\). Replacing the ATE image by either \(\mathfrak I_a^r\) image gives simultaneous coverage of both target-arm closures on the same event. Coverage holds at \(\tau_{a,b}^r(P)=0\) because projection precedes application of the exact-set map; zero-mass candidate cells are excluded without excluding the strictly positive population pair fixed by \(\mathcal J=\operatorname{Supp}_P(D,Z)\).
body.justification: Projection of the explicit primitive-moment image preserves finite-sample honesty despite branch discontinuity.
body.gap: BanKedagni2022 treats intersection-bound outer formulas, while calibrated projection and perturbed-LP methods do not directly cover a support-filtered union whose components disappear.
body.consumer: NLSYM-style and air-pollution analyses can report a conservative confidence region for the entire exact population set, including a zero-slack diagnostic.
